title: LRU Cache (Simple)
description:
Implement an `LRUCache` class with a fixed `capacity`. Implement `get(key)` returning the value or `-1`, and `put(key, value)` inserting/updating. When over capacity, evict the least recently used entry.

**Example:**
```js
const cache = new LRUCache(2);
cache.put('a', 1); cache.put('b', 2);
cache.get('a');    // 1 (a is now most recent)
cache.put('c', 3); // evicts 'b'
cache.get('b');    // -1
```
ai_context: The elegant solution exploits Map's insertion order — moving a key to the end on access and evicting the first key. Common mistake: implementing a full doubly-linked list unnecessarily, or forgetting to update recency on get.
